SELECT ps.id, pd.sku_no, pd.id AS sku_id, pd.images_url,
FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON ps.sku_id = pd."id" AND ps.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.product_id = #{productId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pd.id desc

SELECT ps.id, pd.sku_no, ps.listing_time AS newListingTime FROM product_sale ps INNER JOIN product_detail pd ON ps.sku_id = pd.id AND ps.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE
AND ps.listing_time IS NOT NULL
AND ps.listing_time IS NULL
